[2:11PM] #Apapa #TrafficUpdate 

Nagaff junction down to Airways towards Flour mills is good to go. 

Flour mills inward Eleganza roundabout down to Etisalat towards Mr Biggs is also in good shape.

Return journey from Mr Biggs to Etisalat towards Eleganza is also in order.

Eleganza towards Port gate axis is very busy due to activities within the port axis but our officers are managing the traffic effectively on the corridor.

Return journey from Port gate down to Eleganza towards Airways is good to go.

Approaching Area B connecting Leventis bridge outward Apapa is also in good shape.
